kind: Exact composition prototype; not a shared cross-platform component package

daoUI.color: tokens.json via the existing Jera app.tamber mapping
daoUI.typography: type.json; named family/size styles in dao.contract
daoUI.composition: rn/reading/README.md guidance, adapted to Exact rather than copied React Native source

layout.adapter: named spacing, radius and touch-target functions in dao.contract

local_expression: Shared chrome, post author and thread components. Canonical type sizes/leading are retained; scalable insets contain browser font ink. Reading width, post spacing and preview-only fixture state are local composition choices. Gold action colors retain David's existing approved Jera mapping.
limits: No login, network requests, backend writes or live model replies
Post and per-thread drafts reset on reload
Web evidence does not establish native typing or sheet behavior
